texts.preamble: Gurugubelli .Srinivasa Rao vs Panuganti Anjan Kumar on 29 February, 2020 Author: J. Uma Devi Bench: J.Uma Devi The Hon'Ble Ms.JUSTICE J.Uma Devi Criminal Petition No.1197 Of 2020 Order:
texts.facts: This criminal petition is filed by the petitioners/ A-1 to A-4, seeking to quash the proceedings in Crime No.23 of 2020 Ichapuram Town Police Station, Srikakulam District, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 270, 272, 273, 328 r/w 34 I.P.C and Section 20(2), 22(B) of Cigarettes and other Tobacco Products Act, 2003. The case on hand has also been filed questioning the proceedings in Crime No.23 of 2020 Ichapuram Town Police Station, Srikakulam District, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 270, 272, 273, 328 r/w 34 I.P.C and Section 20(2), 22(B) of Cigarettes and other Tobacco Products Act, 2003, against the petitioners/ A-1 to A-4.
